arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Incinerate{/c} maximum damage bonus while channeling is increased to {c_number}[SF_13|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Incinerate's{/c} Size is increased by {c_number}[SF_14 * 100|%|]{/c} when you reach the maximum damage bonus.
{c_important}Incinerate{/c} gains {c_number}2{/c} additional beams and deals its Burning damage {c_number}[SF_37 * 100 |%|]{/c} faster, but its range is reduced.

{c_important}Incinerate{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

{c_important}Incinerate's{/c} beam no longer penetrates enemies and it now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage to the first enemy hit and an additional {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_SECONDARY_DAMAGE}{/c} damage distributed among up to {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} enemies around them.
{c_important}Incinerate{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_15 * 100 |x%|]{/c} increased damage while you are {u}{c_important}Healthy{/c}{/u}.
{c_important}Incinerate{/c} heals you for {c_number}[SF_22 * 100 |%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_22]){/c} per enemy hit.
{c_important}Incinerate{/c} gains a {c_number}[SF_23 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of {u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u}.
